title: Spider Tree
body:
Spider Tree

The Spider Tree is a tree found in Finlay Island. It was released for the 2025 Halloween event, and when chopped down, drops spiders ,spider webs and plastic spiders.

Selling Price

The selling price of Spider trees (raw, sanded, and planked) can vary day to day. See the stock market located in the Resource Hub to see the exact price of Spider on a particular day. The price listed on the wiki is the default price for selling raw or processed Spider Tree Wood.

  • Logged (Raw) - ~🍬1.164/stud³.
  • Sanded - ~🍬22.93/stud³.
  • Planked - ~🍬28.51/stud³.

Foraging

  • Spiders
  • Spider Webs

Accessibility

Certain trees require specific conditions to obtain them, whether it be a specific axe or a weather condition. Detailed spawn conditions and other concerns (such as the relative difficulty of farming this tree) are also listed in the following:

  • Spider Tree is a Halloween Exclusive tree
  • Can be logged using the Refined axe or higher.
  • Can be sanded using the Industrial sander or higher.
  • Can be planked using the Steel planker or higher.
  • Spider spawn conditions include the following:
    • Spider trees must spawn on the surface.
    • They usually spawn on stone/dirt (not to be confused with grass).

Trivia

  • This tree drops ~10-15 spiders on the ground that chase you. But they are pretty slow and do low damage.
  • the tree triggers my arachnophobia 😔
  • Chopping this tree with the Living Axe, will keep the spider webs in the branches, but the spiders still fall.
  • Because of how spider trees generate, they can sometimes spawn on the side of hills, making them slightly glitch into terrain.
